title: A stable item identifier survives a transformation while attributes change
summary: A transformation model treats one token slot as an item identity carried through successive operations; material/state attributes may change, but the identity marker remains linked.

design.unit: two-step transformation record with a source item, operation, and resulting item
design.contrast: same individual through change versus newly introduced item
design.prediction: In held multi-step records, the identity-bearing form should recur at source and result positions even when state/material attributes differ; a new item requires an explicit introduction marker.
design.countermodel: The same surface pattern could arise from a context-conditioned lexical convention or editorial packaging without the proposed semantic mechanism.
design.falsifier: A result changes state but uses the introduction pattern while the source identity pattern persists, or identity recurrence occurs across unrelated records without a transformation link.
design.principal_risk: Independent item identity is currently unavailable. Near apposition/reference and relation-chain ideas, but requires persistence across change rather than adjacency or document direction.
